threat_event: Attacker in dispatch changes routes or consignees for hazmat loads to divert them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TMS dispatch changes are not alerted; security plan has no cyber measures
treatment_plan: Alert on consignee and route changes for security plan loads; two-person approval

threat_event: Telematics vendor compromise disables tracking and panic alerts
treatment_plan: Check calls when tracking is lost; vendor incident notice terms
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: Shared ELD support accounts hide who edited hours of service records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared ELD support accounts at 6 terminals
treatment_plan: Unique accounts for all ELD support personnel
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: Ransomware stops electronic shipping papers and dispatch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipping papers depend on ERP and the TMS
existing_controls: Paper papers from shippers; hourly TMS backups
treatment_plan: Terminal print kits with pre-printed papers; tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Driver qualification and drug and alcohol testing records are breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS records for about 4,600 current and former drivers
treatment_plan: Vendor access review; least privilege for terminal staff
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

threat_event: Driver-facing camera AI scores lead to unfair discipline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scores feed discipline without documented human review
regulatory_driver: State AI employment laws (Illinois HB 3773; Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01)
treatment_plan: Documented review before discipline; notice to drivers (P10)
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance
